one_liner: Cloud communications APIs for SMS, voice, WhatsApp, email and verification.
access_notes: Sign up for a free trial without a credit card; get Account SID and Auth Token; upgrade for full usage.
mcp_note: twilio-labs/mcp (@twilio-alpha/mcp) exposes all of Twilio's public APIs as MCP tools; Twilio calls it one of 'our official' servers. The separate twilio.com/docs/ai/mcp server is docs-search only.
blocker_note: Trial limits (free units, verified numbers) until upgrade; some products need carrier approval.
adjudication: v1 right, verifier wrong: verifier saw only the docs-search MCP and downgraded to community.
